title: Report delivery, recipients and failure recovery
question: Who may receive a report, including external addresses? Is eligibility checked again at send time after membership changes? What does the requester see when generation or email fails? How are duplicate emails avoided?
context: Today the report owner acknowledges the callback and claims "notified" before email delivery finishes, so a delivery failure can be lost (RPT-REQ-004). Scheduled reports always add the requester as a recipient (RPT-REQ-007).
